usage_rule: Creator content is benchmark evidence only and never auto-promoted to finance fact. Official/company claims remain attributed; forward-looking items remain conditional.

benchmark_evidence.source: ../p04/P04_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md#1-三个频道不是同一种点击模型

benchmark_evidence.source: ../p04/P04_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md#2-问句是台股频道的品牌基线不是已证实的增长按钮
benchmark_evidence.finding: Questions were common in Taiwan packaging but were not proven to cause higher performance.

benchmark_evidence.source: ../p04/P04_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md#3-科技频道的统一三行封面更像品牌系统而非单片爆款因子
benchmark_evidence.finding: The three-line technology layout appeared in both high- and low-performing videos.

benchmark_evidence.source: ../p04/P04_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md#4-宏观频道唯一-breakout-是专家--长周期叙事但仍是单例
benchmark_evidence.finding: The sole breakout paired expert authority with a long-cycle bridge.
benchmark_evidence.limitation: Single case with guest, timing and distribution confounds.

benchmark_evidence.source: ../p04/P04_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md#5-30-条中建立了可用但仍属-provisional-的频道内基线
benchmark_evidence.finding: P04 created a provisional age-adjusted, within-channel performance baseline.
benchmark_evidence.limitation: Small sample; duration, type and exposure unavailable.

benchmark_evidence.source: ../p04/P04_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md#6-ai-最常见但最常见不等于最容易跑赢
benchmark_evidence.finding: AI was most frequent and near baseline; macro and earnings medians were higher in smaller samples.

benchmark_evidence.source: ../p04/P04_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md#7-机会词与高表现共同出现得比纯风险词多但频道与题材严重混杂
benchmark_evidence.finding: Opportunity language co-occurred with high performance more often than risk language.
benchmark_evidence.limitation: Channel and topic confounding; no causal claim.

benchmark_evidence.source: ../p04/P04_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md#8-标题长度反映节目任务不宜用统一字数规则
benchmark_evidence.finding: Title length varied with program task, not a universal optimum.

benchmark_evidence.source: ../p04/P04_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md#9-高表现封面没有单一共同公式最稳定的是清楚层级
benchmark_evidence.finding: No single visual formula emerged; one clear primary hierarchy was the most stable shared feature.

benchmark_evidence.source: ../p04/P04_BENCHMARK_REPORT.md#10-标题与封面应分工简单重复只适合极短决策题
benchmark_evidence.finding: Title and thumbnail commonly split or compress information; complex topics benefit from complementary roles.
benchmark_evidence.limitation: Efficiency hypothesis is unvalidated without CTR.

evidence.title: TSMC 2Q26 Earnings Release
verified_claims: 2Q26 revenue NT$1,270.38 billion, net income NT$706.56 billion, diluted EPS NT$27.25.
Revenue increased 36.0% year over year and 12.0% quarter over quarter.
evidence.limitations: Company-reported quarterly release; outlook is forward-looking.

evidence.title: TSMC 2Q26 Management Report
verified_claims: Gross margin was 67.7% and operating margin was 60.3%.
2nm/3nm/5nm/7nm contributed 3%/30%/33%/11% of wafer revenue; advanced nodes were 77%.
HPC was 66% and smartphone 22% of net revenue by platform; HPC rose 20% sequentially while smartphone declined 4%.
North America represented 78% of revenue by customer headquarters.
3Q26 revenue guidance was US$44.6–45.8 billion at NT$32 per US dollar; gross margin 65–67% and operating margin 56–58%.
Margin improvement reflected cost improvement and utilization, partly offset by overseas-fab dilution.
evidence.limitations: Company management report; guidance and management explanations are not guaranteed outcomes.

evidence.title: TSMC Monthly Revenue 2026
verified_claims: June 2026 revenue was NT$442,680 million, up 67.9% year over year.
January–June 2026 revenue was NT$2,404,484 million, up 35.6% year over year.
evidence.limitations: Monthly revenue is unaudited and does not establish profit or stock-price direction.

evidence.title: UMC Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results
verified_claims: 2Q26 revenue was NT$68.73 billion, gross margin 32.5%, operating margin 21.8% and utilization 85%.
22/28nm represented 37% of wafer revenue.
UMC raised 2026 capital expenditure to US$2 billion and expected 3Q utilization above 90%.
UMC said it shipped its first 12-inch silicon-photonics mass-production wafers and plans a platform in 2027.
evidence.limitations: Company release; outlook and platform timing are forward-looking.

evidence.title: MediaTek Investor Relations event listing
verified_claims: MediaTek listed its 2Q26 investor conference for July 31, 2026.
evidence.limitations: Only the event occurrence was verified here; result figures were not extracted.

evidence.title: Hon Hai investor event calendar
verified_claims: Hon Hai listed its 2Q26 investor conference for August 12, 2026 and a July unaudited revenue event for August 5, 2026.
evidence.limitations: Event occurrence only; no financial figures were extracted for this artifact.

evidence.title: Exports and Imports in June 2026
verified_claims: June 2026 exports were US$74.83 billion, up 40.3% year over year.
Imports were US$62.63 billion, up 51.8%, leaving a US$12.20 billion trade surplus.
evidence.limitations: Aggregate trade data do not by themselves identify company earnings or stock returns.

evidence.title: AMD Investor Relations current announcements
verified_claims: AMD announced on May 21 that next-generation EPYC Venice was ramping on TSMC 2nm.
AMD announced more than US$10 billion of Taiwan ecosystem investment on May 21.
AMD listed an acquisition of Taalas on August 6 and AI partnerships with Anthropic and Microsoft in July.
evidence.limitations: Announcement summaries; partnership deployment, acquisition benefits and investment impact remain subject to execution.

evidence.title: Delta Investor Relations
verified_claims: Delta listed a 2Q26 analyst meeting for July 30, 2026.
evidence.limitations: Event occurrence only; result figures were not extracted.

evidence.title: NVIDIA 2nd Quarter FY27 Financial Results event
verified_claims: NVIDIA scheduled its second-quarter FY27 results event for August 26, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time.
evidence.limitations: The event had not occurred as of this artifact date; no FY27 Q2 result may be stated.

evidence.title: AMD Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
verified_claims: 2Q26 revenue was US$11.536 billion, up 50% year over year; GAAP gross margin was 54%.
Data Center revenue was US$6.7 billion, up 107% year over year and 58% of company revenue.
3Q26 revenue outlook was about US$13 billion plus or minus US$300 million, with non-GAAP gross margin about 56%.
AMD disclosed an Anthropic partnership for up to 2GW of MI450 deployments and expanded Microsoft collaboration.
evidence.limitations: Company release; non-GAAP measures require reconciliation and outlook/partnership quantities are forward-looking.

evidence.title: Meta Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
verified_claims: 2Q26 revenue was US$60.801 billion, up 28% year over year.
Costs and expenses were US$42.026 billion, up 55%; operating margin was 31% versus 43% a year earlier.
Capital expenditures including principal payments on finance leases were US$31.08 billion.
Daily active people were 3.60 billion, ad impressions rose 14% and average price per ad rose 12%.
evidence.limitations: Company release; management outlook and AI returns are uncertain.

evidence.title: Tesla Second Quarter 2026 Production, Deliveries & Deployments
verified_claims: 2Q26 production was 451,758 vehicles, deliveries were 480,126, and energy-storage deployments were 13.5 GWh.
Tesla cautioned that deliveries are only two measures and should not be treated as an indicator of quarterly financial performance.
evidence.limitations: Operational release, not a complete income statement or cash-flow assessment.

evidence.title: Tesla Releases Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
verified_claims: Tesla published its second-quarter 2026 financial-results release on July 22, 2026.
evidence.limitations: Result figures were not extracted for this artifact.

evidence.title: Amazon Q2 2026 results webcast announcement
verified_claims: Amazon scheduled its second-quarter 2026 results conference call for July 30, 2026.
evidence.limitations: Event occurrence only; result figures were not extracted.

evidence.title: Microsoft FY26 Q4 earnings-release date announcement
verified_claims: Microsoft announced that FY26 Q4 results would be published July 29, 2026.
evidence.limitations: Event occurrence only; Q4 result figures were not extracted.

evidence.title: Microsoft FY26 Q3 Earnings
verified_claims: FY26 Q3 revenue was US$82.9 billion, up 18% year over year.
Microsoft reported AI annual recurring revenue above US$37 billion, up 123%.
Management discussed roughly US$190 billion of 2026 capital expenditure including higher component pricing and said cloud capacity could remain constrained through 2026.
evidence.limitations: Older-quarter baseline; management commentary and capital expenditure expectations are forward-looking.

evidence.title: Apple Newsroom July 2026 Broadcom supply-chain announcement
verified_claims: Apple announced it would increase spending with Broadcom to produce billions more chips in the United States.
evidence.limitations: The newsroom announcement does not establish supplier revenue timing or stock-price impact.

evidence.title: Broadcom Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Results
verified_claims: Broadcom published fiscal second-quarter 2026 results and guided third-quarter non-GAAP operating income to about 67% of projected revenue.
evidence.limitations: Non-GAAP outlook is company guidance and not a guaranteed result.

evidence.title: Intel to report second-quarter 2026 results
verified_claims: Intel scheduled its second-quarter 2026 financial-results release for July 23, 2026.
evidence.limitations: Event occurrence only; Q2 result figures were not extracted.

evidence.title: Federal Reserve FOMC statement
verified_claims: The FOMC maintained the federal-funds target range at 3.5%–3.75%.
The decision passed 9–3; three members preferred a 25-basis-point increase.
evidence.limitations: The statement does not predict market returns; transmission depends on expectations and subsequent data.

evidence.title: US GDP Advance Estimate, Second Quarter 2026
verified_claims: Real GDP increased at a 1.5% annualized rate in 2Q26 versus 2.1% in 1Q26.
Real private domestic final sales increased 3.9% versus 1.7% in 1Q26.
PCE prices rose 5.1% and core PCE prices 3.4% in the quarter.
The second estimate is scheduled for August 26, 2026.
evidence.limitations: Advance estimates are revised and quarter-to-quarter annualized rates can be volatile.

evidence.title: US CPI Summary, July 2026
verified_claims: CPI rose 0.1% in July and 3.4% over 12 months.
Core CPI rose 0.2% in July and 2.5% over 12 months.
evidence.limitations: CPI is one inflation measure and does not mechanically determine Fed policy or equity returns.

evidence.title: US Employment Situation, July 2026
verified_claims: July payroll employment declined by 23,000 and unemployment was 4.1%.
Average hourly earnings increased by US$0.02.
evidence.limitations: Payroll data are revised and one month does not establish a trend.

evidence.title: US Producer Price Index, July 2026
verified_claims: The Producer Price Index for final demand was unchanged in July 2026.
evidence.limitations: Aggregate PPI does not map one-to-one to consumer inflation or company margins.

evidence.title: US Advance Monthly Retail Trade, July 2026
verified_claims: July retail and food-service sales were US$763.6 billion, down 0.6% month over month and up 5.0% year over year.
May–July sales were 6.3% above the same period a year earlier.
evidence.limitations: Advance estimates are revised and nominal sales include price effects.

evidence.title: US Advance Economic Indicators, June 2026
verified_claims: June goods trade deficit was US$101.5 billion, down from US$105.9 billion in May.
Goods exports were US$204.7 billion and imports US$306.2 billion; both declined from May.
evidence.limitations: Advance estimates are revised and do not alone establish equity-market direction.

evidence.title: US GDP second-estimate release schedule
verified_claims: BEA scheduled the second estimate of 2Q26 GDP for August 26, 2026.
evidence.limitations: Future release; revised figures were unavailable as of the artifact date.
